mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines by > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises by > 200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts revenue growth for S&P 500 constituents and produces positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 rises by > 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO rises by > 1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 5% signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST rises by > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
